title: ‘Crypto King’ Aiden Pleterski found guilty of fraud at his jury trial in Toronto
summary: Self-described ‘Crypto King’ Aiden Pleterski was found guilty of fraud over $5,000 by the jury at his Toronto trial Thursday morning.

image.caption: Self-described 'Crypto King' Aiden Pleterski has been found guilty of fraud. (aiden.ptrs/Instagram)

blocks.text: Self-described ‘Crypto King’ Aiden Pleterski was found guilty of fraud over $5,000 by the jury at his Toronto trial Thursday morning.
Pleterski represented himself, was denied a mistrial earlier this week
Pleterski, who represented himself at trial, appeared emotional after the verdict was read in Ontario Superior Court.
The jury began deliberations around 10:30 a.m. and came back with their verdict 10 minutes before noon.
